title: Why DOPSR let Grusch talk about downed craft and dead pilots

tellings.quote: this is why it's confusing and why Dave can say we have multiple downcraft and have collected dead pilots

plain: Jake Barber, a helicopter pilot who says he helped retrieve a UFO, talks with podcast host Jesse Michels about David Grusch, a former intelligence official who said publicly in 2023 that the US has several crashed craft and has recovered dead pilots from them. Barber explains why the Pentagon office that reviews what former staff may say in public, called DOPSR, let Grusch say this, and says that is why the picture is confusing. If true, it would mean the government cleared those claims for release on purpose.
